{{Quote|If you hadn't insisted on coming to Ossus &ndash; if you hadn't tried to shoot me in the back &ndash; I might have let you live.|Morrigan Corde to Jor Torlin|<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
The '''Assassination on Ossus''' was an assassination attempt by [[Jor Torlin]], a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] and operative of [[Sith Intelligence and Assassination]], against [[Morrigan Corde]], agent of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. After [[Skirmish on The Wheel|disrupting]] a meeting between [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mingo Bovark]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]], the two agents went to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] to complete their mission to capture [[Cade Skywalker]].<ref name="Legacy 10" />

However, once on the planet's jungles, Torlin turned against Corde and attempted to kill her. Corde defended herself and then activated micro-ampule filled with a nerve toxin she had inserted on Torlin's body while he had been unconscious at [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. After Torlin began to feel the effects of the toxin and collapsed, Corde left him to die in the middle of the jungle and left Ossus on Torlin's personal ship, the [[Raider (Gladius-class)|''Raider'']].<ref name="Legacy 10" />
